sections.subhead: Payroll, Attendance, and Leave Managed in One System Your HR Team Actually Trusts

body.text: Teknoppy builds custom HRM software in Kochi that runs payroll, attendance, leave and employee records in one cloud system. We map your HR policies, migrate existing records and train your team. Most projects go live in 4-10 weeks.

Choosing the right HRM Software Company in Kochi matters because HR software touches sensitive records — employee salaries, statutory taxes, performance appraisals, and leave allowances. Unlike rigid SaaS tools with perpetual monthly per-user fees, our custom HRM platforms are built around your exact company policies, fully compliant with Indian payroll regulations, and 100% owned by you.

sections.h2: What Our HRM & Payroll Software Includes

items.title: Indian Payroll & Statutory Compliance
items.html: Automates monthly salary processing, Provident Fund (PF) and Employee State Insurance (ESI) deductions, Kerala State Professional Tax, TDS calculations, and digital Form 16 generation. Exports bank-ready NEFT/RTGS batch payout files.

items.title: Biometric & Attendance Sync
items.html: Integrates with biometric fingerprint and facial recognition hardware (ZKTeco, eSSL) via secure APIs. Supports multi-shift rosters, rotational shifts, overtime rules, and mobile geo-fenced check-in for field employees.

items.title: Leave & Employee Self-Service (ESS)
items.html: Allows employees to download password-protected payslips, submit leave applications, check leave balances, and update personal profiles without overburdening HR personnel.

items.title: Enterprise Security & DPDP Compliance
items.html: Granular role-based access control (Admin, HR, Manager, Employee), encrypted salary records, and data management aligned with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023.

items.title: Performance & Recruitment Workflows
items.html: Tracks quarterly reviews, KPIs, and appraisal cycles alongside applicant tracking and onboarding workflows for hiring teams.

items.title: ERP & Financial System Integration
items.html: Connects payroll registers directly into your general ledger, Tally, or enterprise resource planning system. See our ERP Development and Dashboard Development Services.

sections.h2: Custom HRM Software or Keka / greytHR / Zoho People?

items.title: Off-the-Shelf SaaS (Keka, greytHR, Zoho People)
items.text: SaaS platforms are quick to set up for standard businesses. However, monthly recurring per-employee subscription fees compound substantially as your workforce expands. Customizing Kerala-specific shift rules or non-standard salary structures is often restricted, and your proprietary workforce data lives on multi-tenant third-party servers.

items.title: Teknoppy Custom HRM Software
items.text: Custom HRM software eliminates recurring monthly seat licensing fees forever. It is built strictly around your shift timings, attendance rules, and incentive formulas. You maintain complete sovereignty over your employee databases and own 100% of the source code.

items.title: 1. HR Policy & Workflow Mapping
items.text: We review your salary structures, allowance breakdowns, PF/ESI eligibility, leave categories, and approval hierarchies before writing code.

items.title: 2. Architecture & Compliance Setup
items.text: We configure statutory tax brackets, Kerala Professional Tax slabs, and integrate attendance hardware protocols.

items.title: 3. Custom Build & Portal Configuration
items.text: We develop the HR administrative console, manager approval flows, and the employee self-service mobile-friendly portal.

items.title: 4. Data Migration & Payroll Parallel Run
items.text: We securely migrate historical employee files and run parallel payroll calculations against your previous records to guarantee 100% mathematical accuracy.

items.title: 5. Training & Go-Live
items.text: Hands-on training for HR administrators and employees, ensuring seamless day-one adoption.

sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — HRM Software Company Kochi

items.q: Does your HRM software handle Indian statutory compliance like PF, ESI, and TDS?
items.a: Yes. Our custom payroll systems automatically calculate Employee Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), Kerala State Professional Tax, and TDS deductions based on the latest tax slabs, generating government-compliant monthly reporting sheets and Form 16 files.

items.q: How much does custom HRM software cost in Kochi?
items.a: Custom HRM software typically ranges from ₹65,000 to ₹1,20,000 for core payroll and attendance systems (4–6 weeks), and ₹1,40,000 to ₹2,80,000+ for enterprise multi-branch suites with employee self-service and performance tracking (6–10 weeks). Because you own the software, there are no monthly per-employee fees.

items.q: Can the system sync with our existing biometric attendance machines?
items.a: Yes. We integrate directly with popular biometric attendance systems including ZKTeco, eSSL, Realtime, and facial recognition devices via local databases or cloud REST APIs to sync punch times in real time.

items.q: Can employees access their own payslips and leave balances?
items.a: Yes. The employee self-service (ESS) portal allows staff to view and download password-protected monthly payslips, submit leave applications, view remaining balances, and upload tax declarations from desktop or mobile devices.

items.q: How is employee salary and personal data secured?
items.a: We implement strict role-based access control, encryption in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and at rest, automated encrypted backups, and audit logs adhering to the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023.

items.q: How long does custom HRM implementation take?
items.a: A standard implementation takes 4 to 10 weeks depending on the number of modules, customization requirements, and biometric device integration. We conduct parallel payroll validation to ensure 100% accuracy before go-live.
